label_structure: Exactly one complete, nonempty decision tag; wrapper and non-label field warnings do not invalidate a clear label.
positive_patterns: ^(?:based on the analysis, i conclude that )?(?:a )?continuity error (?:exists|(?:is )?found|is present)(?:[.!]| in the story(?:[.,!]| because | due to )| due to |$)
^there is a continuity error in the story[.!]
evidence_policy: Bound fields at the next schema tag (or unknown closing tag); report missing/mismatched closing tags. Preserve legacy line cleanup and non-strict overlap; reject empty normalized fragments on predicted and gold sides.
invalid_policy: Retain null labels as separate invalid-positive-gold and invalid-negative-gold counts; zero correctness/localisation credit. All-scope recall and specificity use all gold positives and negatives. F1 includes invalid gold of its own class as missed class instances.
